summary: Scheduled CSV report splits tracehook param on comma causing missing trace links after retention compaction
description:
Issue summary: Customer scheduled CSV report that includes embedded dashboard tracehook parameters (used for drilldowns into traces) is producing CSV rows where the tracehook field is split into multiple columns when the tracehook parameter contains a comma. This causes downstream workflows and emailed CSVs to show truncated trace links, breaking alert context linking and investigator workflows. Problem was reported after a retention compaction run earlier this week.

Impact: For FinSight (Enterprise tenant), scheduled daily CSVs from dashboards that include tracehook-anchored filters are missing valid trace links in approx. 12% of rows for ranges spanning retention-prune windows. This prevents their on-call and audit teams from following alerts back to traces. No customer data exposure; primarily usability and observability loss.

Scope: Reproducible for scheduled exports only (ad-hoc UI/Download appears correct). Seems triggered when export pipeline pulls compacted index snapshots and passes tracehook through legacy CSV sanitizer that treats commas as separators even when field is quoted.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer config: scheduled CSV snapshot of dashboard with variable 'tracehook' configured as a URL param containing commas (example: 'traceId=abc,context=prod').
Set scheduled report to daily and run once crossing a retention compaction window (we reproduced in prod after retention job at 2026-03-09T03:00Z).
Observe scheduled emailed CSV and S3 object: the tracehook column is split into two columns; resulting link is broken and trace id is only partially present.
Ad-hoc: Export same dashboard manually from UI -> Download CSV immediately; compare: manual CSV quotes the tracehook field correctly and link resolves.

2026-03-09T03:01:12Z export-service.WARN sanitizer: unquoted_field_detected field=tracehook value="traceId=abc,context=prod" action=split_applied
2026-03-09T03:01:12Z notify.INFO email=reports+finsight@customer.delivery report=rep-892 size=42KB rows=480 tracehook_splits=58
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: CSV sanitizer regression in legacy path used by scheduled exports when reading compacted snapshots; ad-hoc path uses newer CSV writer that enforces quoting.

Reproduced in prod with a synthetic scheduled job for internal tenant with tracehook containing comma; confirmed split occurs only when export_service loads 'compact' snapshot index (retention-compacted shard).

Checked exporter code path: scheduled exports still route through export-service:legacy_writer when snapshot_type == 'compact' (recent change in retention job introduced snapshot metadata flag 'compact' on 2026-03-08).

Review of sanitizer: legacy_writer relies on CSV library v0.9 which is configured with delimiter=',' and escape/quoting is conditional based on 'is_wrapped' flag. Compact snapshots lost the 'is_wrapped' flag during compaction step, introduced by retention PR #483 (see linked PR).
comments: Mariana Gomez (Support): Customer reports 12% of rows missing trace links in daily scheduled report delivered 2026-03-09. Provided sample CSV and timestamp. Asked for investigation and ETA for fix.

Ethan Brooks (SRE): Confirmed reproducer in prod. Initial fix candidate: route scheduled exports to new csv-writer (non-legacy) for compact snapshots or ensure compaction preserves 'is_wrapped' metadata. Adding INT-2123 to track fix in export-service.

SRE-Team (note): Holding change until risk window; proposed hotfix: on export read path, if snapshot_type=='compact' and field contains comma, force-quote field before writing. Quick patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reports/pull/824

Customer (FinSight) via CS rep: 'We rely on scheduled CSVs for nightly triage — any ETA?'. Mariana responded: 'Working on a hotfix for scheduled exports; will ship toggle to force-quote for affected tenants within 24 hours.'
resolution_notes:
Workaround: Enabled per-tenant toggle to force-quote all fields on scheduled export pipeline for FinSight (feature_flag=force_quote_exports for tenant finsight). This prevented further broken CSVs while a code fix is reviewed.

Permanent fix: PR #824 modifies export-service legacy_writer to treat compact snapshots as having 'is_wrapped'=true at read-time and upgrades sanitized-csv to explicit quoting-in-all-cases mode. Deployed to canary on 2026-03-13 and rolled to prod on 2026-03-14 02:30Z.

Post-deploy validation: re-ran customer's scheduled report for 2026-03-14; CSV attached by CS to customer; tracehook column intact and links resolve. Monitoring: export-service.alerts.csv-field-splits rate dropped to 0 in last 24h.

Follow-ups: 1) Add unit/integration test covering comma-containing tracehook fields across snapshot types. 2) Update retention compaction job to preserve 'is_wrapped' marker or annotate resulting snapshot explicitly. 3) Add telemetry to scheduled export path to detect future sanitizer regressions. Assigned INT-2123 for follow-up engineering work.
